headword: コストパフォーマンス
reading: こすとぱふぉーまんす

definitions.explanation: The ratio of what you get to what you pay. Used positively (good value) or negatively (poor value), and applied to products, services, or experiences. Commonly abbreviated as コスパ.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コストパフォーマンス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This shop has good value for money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧わり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧コストパフォーマンス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: The value for money is poor relative to the price.

examples.japanese: コストパフォーマンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}して→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I choose home appliances with an emphasis on cost-performance.

notes:
Loanword from English. In conversation, the clipped form ⟦コスパ→コスパ：04739_kosupa⟧ is far more common; the full form appears in writing and formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コストパフォーマンス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: good cost-performance
- コストパフォーマンス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: poor cost-performance
- コストパフォーマンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to prioritize value for money

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コスパ→コスパ：04739_kosupa⟧: clipped colloquial form — much more common in speech
- ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to be worth it — verb-phrase synonym
